title: August and the Typewriter
author: Xanthe Vane
blurb: Jonah Ashgrove, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
